name: What is a roof valley, and why does it leak?

mainEntity.name: What is a roof valley, and why does it leak?

acceptedAnswer.text: A roof valley is where two roof slopes meet, forming a V-shape that channels water. Leaks often occur in valleys due to improper flashing installation, damaged shingles, accumulation of debris, or wear and tear over time. Water pooling or freezing in a poorly designed or maintained valley can cause materials to deteriorate, leading to water penetration into your home. Regular inspection can help identify potential issues before they become major leaks.
